source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of probability in inheritance (PDF 89-90).

blocks.text: Genes aik nasl se doosri mein ittefaqan jate hain, is liye naye allele milapon ka imkaan riyazi ehtimal (mathematical probability) se nikala jata hai: koi khaas nateeja kitni baar aata hai. Aik ya do genes (jaise RrYy x RrYy) ke liye Punnett square kaam karta hai, lekin bohat se genes (jaise AaBbCcDdEe x AaBbCcDdEe) ke liye bohat bara ho jata hai, is liye ehtimal ke qawaid use hote hain.

Ehtimal kisi waqiye ke hone ki tadaad ko kul mumkina nataij se taqseem karne se milta hai. Agar 7,324 beejon mein 1,850 jhurridar hon to ehtimal 1,850 / 7,324 = 0.253 hai, yaani taqreeban 4 mein se 1 beej.
Do ya zyada azad waqiyat ke ikatthe hone ka imkaan un ke alag alag ehtimalaat ka hasil zarb hai. Aik dice par chhakka 1/6 hai, to do dice par do chhakke 1/6 x 1/6 = 1/36.

items: Aa x Aa: har walid 1/2 ehtimal se a gamete deta hai, to aa bachcha = 1/2 x 1/2 = 1/4.
RrYy x RrYy: gol = 3/4 aur peela = 3/4, to gol peela = 3/4 x 3/4 = 9/16.

blocks.text: Aise waqiyat jin mein aik waqt mein sirf aik ho sakta hai (mutually exclusive), un mein se kisi aik ka ehtimal un ke ehtimalaat ka jama hai. Chhe rukh wale dice par 1 ya 6 aana 1/6 + 1/6 = 1/3 hai. Aa x Aa mein dominant phenotype teen tareeqon se banta hai, A + A, A + a aur a + A, har aik 1/4, is liye is ka ehtimal 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4 = 3/4 hai.
Kitab ke masail hal ke saath

blocks.prompt: Phenylketonuria aur albinism recessive hain aur azadana alag hote hain. Dono walidain dono ke liye heterozygous hain. Bachche mein (a) phenylketonuria, (b) albinism, (c) dono ka imkaan kya hai?
blocks.explanation: (a) 1/4, Pp x Pp se. (b) 1/4, Aa x Aa se. (c) Product rule se 1/4 x 1/4 = 1/16.

blocks.prompt: CC x Cc cross mein homozygous dominant, homozygous recessive aur heterozygous ka tanasub kya hai?
blocks.explanation: CC walid sirf C deta; Cc walid C ya c barabar deta. To 1/2 CC, 1/2 Cc aur 0 cc.

blocks.prompt: TtYy matar khud-pollinate hota hai. (a) Lamba aur hare beej wala paudha hone ka imkaan? (b) Agar beej lamba aur peele beej wala paudha bane to us ke TTYY hone ka imkaan?
blocks.explanation: (a) Lamba 3/4 x hara 1/4 = 3/16. (b) Lambon mein TT 3 mein se 1 (TT, Tt, tT), aur peelon mein YY 3 mein se 1, to 1/3 x 1/3 = 1/9.

blocks.title: Karna aur likhna: dice phenkna
blocks.text: Har baar chhakka aane ka ehtimal 1/6 hai, pichhle nataij se qata nazar. To 100 baar mein taqreeban 100 x 1/6, yaani lag bhag 17 chhakke mutawaqqa hain; apni ginti likh kar is andaze se muqabla karein.

items: Product rule: azad waqiyat ikatthe, zarb dein.
Sum rule: aik doosre ko khatam karne wale mutabadil, jama karein.
